schema_note: Expected results encode CORRECT semantic SDC behavior (undefined references, duplicates vs legal multiples, conflicts) based on authoritative tool semantics — NOT current tool output.

references.sdc_undefined_ref: Real tools error/warn when -clock / -master_clock / clock-group names reference clocks never defined by create_clock/create_generated_clock. Clock NAMES are always statically resolvable from the SDC; get_ports/get_pins/all_clocks/wildcards are netlist-dependent.
references.sdc_add_delay: Repeated set_input_delay/set_output_delay on the same port+clock REPLACES by default; -add_delay accumulates. -max vs -min and -rise vs -fall are distinct constraints, not duplicates.
references.sdc_case_analysis: Subsequent set_case_analysis on the same pin overrides the earlier value; two different values on one pin in one mode is a conflict to verify.

cases.purpose: set_input_delay -clock references a never-defined clock → SDC-046; MUST NOT fall back to the tightest defined clock (no SDC-008).
create_generated_clock -master_clock names an undefined clock → SDC-047.
set_clock_groups references undefined clock → SDC-048; defined clk_a NOT flagged.
Same pin assigned 0 then 1 → SDC-049 warning carrying BOTH source lines.
-max and -min on same port+clock are legal distinct constraints → no semantic findings.
get_ports/get_pins/all_clocks/wildcard refs are netlist-dependent → never flagged as undefined.
-add_delay accumulation and separate -rise/-fall constraints are legal → no semantic findings.
Realistic SoC SDC with EXACTLY ONE injected defect (clk_ddr undefined) → exactly one SDC-046, no unrelated semantic findings.
Realistic SDC with THREE injected defects → SDC-047, SDC-046, SDC-049 each exactly once, dual-line on SDC-049.
